## Problem and change

Explain the user-visible problem and what this change does.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks performed. Note checks not run and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused scope and follows CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are included.
- [ ] Screenshots/output contain no credentials, personal paths or private project data.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this material under the project's existing license.
